text: Accept Checkpoint 51 as the frozen architecture/runtime-bridge baseline while keeping its AUX/PDS numerical balance provisional.

Use the intended Combat Battery primary candidate at TL1: three finite charges, +1 Tactical Power per charge, maximum one discharge per turn, with charges persisting across encounters until replenishment. Test two charges before considering a TL2 entry-floor move if the primary candidate remains compulsory.

Use the TL2 Power Capacitor as reusable stored power: start with 1 stored TP, discharge +1 TP, then spend 1 TP on a later turn to recharge before another discharge; charging and discharging on the same turn are prohibited.

Tactical shield recharge is a core ship action and is never unlocked by installing Combat Battery, Power Capacitor, or Auxiliary Reactor. Power-support AUX may supply or shift TP but only affects affordability.

Keep AMM readiness at 1 TP at TL1 and TL2, matching Kinetic PDS readiness cost. Preserve Checkpoint 51 PDS accuracy candidates during Checkpoint 52 unless tactical evidence independently justifies an accuracy change.

Evaluate AMM ammunition as campaign endurance. Retain 25 TL1 / 30 TL2 rounds in the primary combat matrix while stress-testing 15, 20, 25, and 30 rounds across repeated demand; do not force routine single-fight depletion.

Evaluate Combat Battery charges, AMM ammunition, and Kinetic/Missile magazine expansion on repeated-engagement resource timescales in addition to duel performance; single-battle parity is not a design requirement for endurance systems.

Keep Checkpoint 51 combat evidence frozen and add a separate Checkpoint 52 stateful 975-variant matrix plus deterministic resource-endurance diagnostics; defer TL3-TL9 runtime population until early resource relationships are reviewed.
